$comment: C36 enrichment sidecar (deep nested repeatable groups + evidence-in-array probe). slc-stand-other, 'Other economic or financial requirements'. The buyer picks a requirement TYPE (CODE_BOOLEAN) then provides one of three mutually-structured blocks; RSG1/RSG1/RSG1 (0..n) is a repeatable 'amount-type' requirement block, each with its own AMOUNT answer whose evidence (QSG1/QSG1, 1..n) carries EVIDENCE_IDENTIFIER inside the repetition. The per-lot RG1 1..n is flattened as in C31.
$shape: CONFIRMED (shape A) against the authoritative C36 instance in espd-validation-schematron/common/xml/ESPD-Request-BASE.xml (uuid ab0e7f2e-...). The buyer picks a requirement TYPE via RQ1 (CODE_BOOLEAN, a radio) whose three values are the EA group codes of the branches: '[Economic or Financial]' (RSG1), '[Rating]' (RSG2), '[Descriptive]' (RSG3). Modeled as three INDEPENDENT properties (amountRequirements[]/rating/descriptive); the three branches are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE at the PRESENTATION level (radio selection), driven by visibleWhen on requirementType — NOT a schema-level union (the EA model does not give a discriminator enum/mapping, so a union would be invented). amountRequirements is 0..n (the buyer may state several economic/financial requirements); rating and descriptive are 0..1.
$arrayModel: Only the first branch (RSG1/RSG1/RSG1, 0..n) is modeled as the array 'amountRequirements[]' with a nested per-answer-evidence array 'amountRequirements[].evidence' holding EVIDENCE_IDENTIFIER — exercising both nested arrays AND evidence-inside-a-repeatable-group. The two 0..1 branches (RSG2 rating, RSG3 descriptive) are singular objects.
$visibleWhen: The three branches are gated by the ENUMERATED requirement type (requirementType), not a boolean ON*/ONTRUE/ONFALSE. The branch visibility is value-equality: amountRequirements shown when requirementType = '[Economic or Financial]', rating when '[Rating]', descriptive when '[Descriptive]'. Declared explicitly in branchSelectors below because this enum-selector gating is a different mechanism from the boolean condition markers the compiler derives automatically.

branchSelectors.$note: Task 7.x — enum-selector visibleWhen for mutually-exclusive branches. Maps a branch's top instance-path segment to the requirementType value that reveals it. The form generator emits visibleWhen { path: <requirementType dataPath>, equals: <value> } for every field under that branch.

C36_slc-stand-other/RG1/RSG1/RSG1/RQ1.$requestValueNote: This leaf's EA value type is CODE_BOOLEAN (boolean-gui-control-type), but it is really the 3-way branch discriminator (Economic/Rating/Descriptive). The UI renders a 3-option selector (presentation optionsOverrides + hints leafShapes enum) whose values match branchSelectors. The EA leaf carries no real enum, so on export emit the BASE constant RADIO_BUTTON_TRUE; the chosen type is a UI-only discriminator, inferred on import from the populated branch. See espd-notes.
